newsitem.title: USA: Jan US steel center shipments best since Apr 1995.
newsitem.headline: Jan US steel center shipments best since Apr 1995.

text.p: The average daily shipping rate for U.S. steel service centers jumped 14.6 percent in January from December, reaching its highest in nearly two years, the Steel Service Center Institute reported.
The previous best figure was in April 1995.
Compared to December, the average daily shipping rate in January was 112,402 tons, with carbon bars up 18.5 percent, carbon flat rolled up 17.6 percent, and carbon plate up 14.9 percent.
Stainless products rose 12.1 percent, carbon tubing up 11.6 percent, and alloy products were up 10.5 percent.
On a seasonally adjusted basis, January was up 3.5 percent over December.
The ending inventory for January dipped below December's total of 6,961,910 tons, finishing at 6,928,923 tons or equivalent to 2.9 months of supply.
Inventory in December equated to 3.4 months of shipments, a high for 1996.
